Body.Content: Azure Security Center helps you prevent, detect, and respond to threats with increased visibility and control over the security of all your Azure resources. It provides a central view of security across your subscriptions, and enables you to set policies and monitor security configurations. Policy-driven recommendations guide resource owners through the process of implementing security controls, and enable them to rapidly deploy integrated Microsoft and partner security solutions. Security-related events from across your Azure deployments are automatically collected and analyzed by using Microsoft global threat intelligence and expertise to identify actual threats and reduce false alarms. The resulting real-time alerts offer insights into the attack campaign and suggest ways to remediate and recover quickly.
Body.Markdown:
Azure Security Center helps you prevent, detect, and respond to threats with increased visibility and control over the security of all your Azure resources. It provides a central view of security across your subscriptions, and enables you to set policies and monitor security configurations.

Policy-driven recommendations guide resource owners through the process of implementing security controls, and enable them to rapidly deploy integrated Microsoft and partner security solutions. Security-related events from across your Azure deployments are automatically collected and analyzed by using Microsoft global threat intelligence and expertise to identify actual threats and reduce false alarms. The resulting real-time alerts offer insights into the attack campaign and suggest ways to remediate and recover quickly.
